scope: Exact native-height terrain occlusion for local point sources; no collision tile promotion, no albedo/emission/gameplay edits.

api.point_visibility_world: (zone,frame,light) combines native sprite volumes and terrain sheets

geometry: Each native painted pixel is a one-pixel projected sheet with retained altitude. Receiver-to-source DDA intersects ray-Z intervals with native height ±0.5. Native height0 and HOLE never block.
receiving_plane: Only terrain-owned receivers may skip their own contiguous constant-height cap or constant-ground-depth front sheet; actors/sprite surfaces never claim that exemption.
broadphase: 8x8 block occupancy from Zone.ground_surfaces (not inferred Field tile planes). Empty blocks skip analytically; viewport rejection occurs before source-cache construction. No production ray-step cap.
cache: 16-entry world-anchored terrain-receiver masks keyed by exact f32 source X/Y/height/radius; color/intensity do not affect visibility. Raised actor/sprite receivers get current-height rays every frame. Eviction changes performance only.
invalidation: Cache belongs to actual Zone-owned Field; native terrain setters invalidate/rebuild it. Prop-only breakage retains unchanged native terrain geometry.

actual_scene_probe.source: PointLight registered by actual regional light hook after native emission-crest repair; physical tip offset is retained.
assertions: source and receiver collision tiles are Floor
receiver lies inside actual source sphere
independent pixel/slab ray clipping crosses actual non-HOLE positive-height native sheets
native DDA blocks actual crystal ray

boundary_correctness: Traversal uses f64 event parameters, direction-aware cell ownership and exact event ties. The cell entered immediately after a negative-axis integer crossing is the lower cell; test builds assert strictly increasing t at every interval.
